heading: Discover, go, listen — the same three taps everywhere in the venue
subhead: One platform runs the whole guest journey, from a guest looking for room 4 to a fan looking for kick-off.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Guest opens the app and sees what's on — session, match or set list, today, and beyond.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: They pick the session, the fixture, or the entertainment night that's relevant to them.

steps.title: Go
steps.text: Clear room, bar or zone details remove the "where do I even stand" friction.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: For TV events, they tune their phone to the right channel. Sound follows them, not the wall.

steps.title: Stay
steps.text: More reasons to stay on-site — and more reasons to come back next Tuesday.
